scenarios.name: retention inherits project then preset and upload overrides without changing old assets
create leaves an asset processing and classify allows it by default
a decided upload reports the person and face detection it turned on, and no test input
moderate decides queued and moderated uploads, and a status alone evaluates every category
moderate is called with each upload's content and its decision fills the report
the decision builder refuses unknown categories and qualifiers, scores outside 0 to 1, and findings without a decision
assets.decide records the API key's decision with its note, and refuses decisions the asset can't take
assets.decide can only block or purge an asset whose processing failed
a reviewer's block shows in retrieve, list, filters and events, and stops delivery
purging removes the content and the CDN refuses it
retainContent keeps content until it is deleted
a key without assets:download cannot read private content
a key with assets:download reads private and age-restricted content
a public age-restricted asset is served without a grant only with ageConfirmed
a limited asset is served from its public URL like an allowed one
an idempotency key replays the first result and refuses a different request
an externalId is unique in the project
the author and the earlier posts CalmLens uses are kept until the content is removed
waitForDecision times out on a pending asset and returns a decided one
hash lists hold entries until the list is deleted
upload presets, settings and metadata fields are ensured by key with revisions
policies keep revisions, reset to their preset and can't be deleted while in use
an organisation's own preset policy switches automatic updates off and on
a folder with assets cannot be deleted
keyword search matches every token in any searchable field, case-insensitively, ranked like the API
filters group with parentheses, and ; binds tighter than ,
filters accept only the API's fields and operators, and * matches regardless of case
tags filter only by membership: =in= has any of the tags, =out= has none
list cursors resume after the last item when assets are created or deleted between pages
enqueued events reach cursors taken before them
update changes only the fields it is given, null clears them, and externalId stays unique
move files an asset into a folder and back to the root, and refuses an unknown folder
an uploaded asset has no children, and listing an unknown asset's children is not found
an image's timeline is empty, a made-up timeline cursor is refused and an unknown asset is not found
retry processes a failed asset again only while it still has content
explain needs a decision, and rerun moderates again unless reviewed or the content is gone
deleting content twice keeps the first removal, and a deleted asset is gone
batch removes content and deletes assets, and an unknown or malformed ID refuses the whole batch
the events feed lists only the requested types and asset, and keeps a cursor to its filters
a reviewer's purge records content-removed before asset.purged
each asset's events carry its own increasing assetSequence, and other events none
events page by pageSize until hasMore is false, with a default of 50 and a maximum of 100
list pages default to 50 items, accept 1 to 100, and a cursor only continues its own query
search uses at most 8 distinct tokens, returns 10 results by default and refuses out-of-range input

scenarios.name: waitForDecision reports the asset's statuses when it times out and refuses a negative timeout
multipart parts arrive in order, need 5 MiB until the last, and finish with the saved queue mode
images in parts can be any size up to 20 MiB, and parts must add up to a declared total
a failed request frees its idempotency key, keys are 1 to 255 printable characters, and surrounding spaces are trimmed
injected failures fail only the request they target, once each, and change nothing
ensureLenses saves new lenses, returns unchanged ones and changes them in place
folders are unique among siblings, list in name order with their ancestors, and search
moving folders refuses cycles and duplicate names, and a folder with subfolders is not empty
an assets:download grant on a folder covers its subfolders only with includeSubfolders
placeholders enforce private and blocked access, revalidate public previews and refuse removed content
each asset type's rendered file and preview, and the CDN serves only the resources an asset has
audio and video have no stream until one is prepared, and the embed page serves every asset
originals carry the CDN's cache tag and protection headers, and images an ETag and Expires
a decided upload records asset.uploaded, asset.classified and the automated decision
a failed upload records asset.uploaded and asset.failed with its reason
completeProcessing decides a pending asset like the pipeline, and refuses one that isn't processing
a reviewer decision is only a test hook for decisions, not pending or failed
without maxRetries a queued failure fails the call once, and the next call succeeds
a queued failure fails one request, so a retry gets the next failure or the API's answer
an injected API error carries the given details and Retry-After
metadata must be a list of { id, value } items, as the API's schema requires
scenarios.untypedArgs: Metadata that isn't a list of { id, value } items can't be held by the SDK's option types.

scenarios.name: an option given as null is left out unless the API takes null for it
a signed URL carries the viewer claims as an unsigned query after the resource
a signed asset URL serves a private asset's resources, and the original only when granted
a private asset's plain URL answers as an unknown asset does, whatever its state, to anyone without the API key
an API-key upload through an upload preset takes its visibility, folder and retention, and keeps to its limits
a mock decision can leave an asset waiting for human review
the decision builder refuses a pending review it can't record
every API operation can be made to fail by name
a failure named for assets.decide fails only that request
a lens sent without active is served, and a patch leaves active as it is
ensuring a preset again with its processing options in another key order keeps its revision
an asset URL and a signed URL name the asset by its external ID
an asset URL's info reports the asset's display fields and the viewer's availability
the CDN refuses a transform it can't read or whose options the schema refuses
uploads of every type the API accepts are stored
moderate gets a multipart upload's parts joined in order, and no content for a website
a transport error or timeout takes no details or Retry-After, and failures name a real operation
a mock built without a project ID uses project-1
